title: Split Concatenated Strings
summary: Given an array of strings, concatenate them into a loop where each string can be reversed or kept as is.
statement: Given an array of strings, concatenate them into a loop where each string can be reversed or kept as is. Identify the lexicographically largest string by cutting the loop at any point to form a regular string. This involves two phases: forming the loop and cutting it to find the largest possible string.
constraints: Each string may be kept or reversed before choosing a cut in the circular concatenation.
hints: Lexicographic order rewards the best possible first character and suffix.
All non-cut strings can independently use their larger orientation.
Try every string as the cut string, both orientations, and all cuts.
Only the cut string is split; every other string should be placed in its individually best orientation.
editorial: Only the cut string is split; every other string should be placed in its individually best orientation.

tests.explanation: Use zyx as the first segment and reverse abc after it, yielding zyxcba.
Every cut and both orientations are considered; cba is largest.
